current_date: June 2025 (adopted by Planning Committee April 2025, in force 1 June 2025)
current_evidence: Planning Committee report 'Adoption of a Local Validation Checklist' (03.04.25) recommends adopting the checklist at Appendix 2 with effect from 1 June 2025; Appendix 2 is titled 'Local Validation Checklist for Planning Applications' dated June 2025. The council-website copy of the list could not be located within budget, so the committee appendix is given as the source.

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank. The list adopted for use from 1 June 2025 is dated June 2025.
issues.evidence: Appendix 2 'Local Validation Checklist for Planning Applications', June 2025 (earlier draft November 2024).

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no requirements. The source has 20 local requirements: Indicative Post Development Biodiversity Gain Plan (if the BNG condition applies and >5 habitat units or medium-high distinctiveness habitat is affected); Bat Survey and Assessment (likely harm to bats or roosts); PEA/EcIA (woodland, hedgerows, ponds within 500m major/250m minor, watercourses within 30m, brownfield/greenfield, designated sites); Site-specific FRA (FZ2/3/3b, FZ1 >=1ha, critical drainage areas; includes Householder); Sustainable Drainage Strategy (major, or surface water drainage in flood-risk areas); Statement of Significance and Heritage Impact Assessment (designated heritage asset; includes Householder); Archaeological Information (tiered by site tier, with Householder at Tier 1); Structural Survey (conversion of countryside buildings, demolition of listed buildings or buildings in a conservation area); Land Contamination Phase 1 (known or suspected contaminated land); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (excavation in a Development High Risk Area, not householder); Ground Conditions and Land Stability Report (Landslide Hazard Zones 1-4); Noise/Nuisance Impact Assessment; Affordable Housing and Developer Contributions Statement (10+ dwellings, with affordable housing and green space at 25+); Transport Assessment (6Cs thresholds, e.g. >50 dwellings, retail >800m2); Climate Change Statement (all major); Self and Custom Build Proforma (any self/custom-build dwelling); Masterplan and Design Statement (>=2ha or 150+ dwellings); Tree Survey/AIA (TPO trees on or adjoining the site, or in a conservation area; includes Householder); Playing Field Impact Assessment; Sequential Test and Retail/Leisure Impact Assessment (out-of-centre >200/280/500m2 thresholds).
issues.evidence: Appendix 2, Part 2 local requirements, with application-type columns H/Min/Oth/Maj/LSM.

issues.detail: All 18 app-type rows say '(none) Not covered'. Householder should show FRA, Heritage Impact Assessment, Archaeology Tier 1, Ground Conditions/Land Stability and Tree Survey. Listed building, advertisement and change of use fall under 'Other' and should show the Oth-column items.
issues.evidence: Appendix 2 key: H = Householder, Oth = changes of use, advertisement consent, listed building consent.
